description: Find products to buy. Searches sellable variants by words, brand, category, purpose, skin type, ingredient, stock and price (SGD cents). Returns variant_id, price and stock for each match; follow next_page for more.

category.description: Category name or slug, e.g. "pantry" or "skincare".

guest_token.description: Optional. Your guest_token from create_cart, if you have one, so this lookup belongs to your shopping session. Not needed to search or read products.

max_price.description: Highest price in SGD cents (S$40 is 4000).

page.description: Result page; use next_page from the previous result.

q.description: Search words, e.g. "cerave cleanser" or "gift for dad under $40". A price phrase sets max_price when it is absent.

name: search_products
